title: clitoria ternatea var. bracteata
intro: Clitoria ternatea var. bracteata, commonly known as the small-flowered butterfly pea or blue pea, is a plant species within the legume family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties, which may help to alleviate stress and improve cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Clitoria ternatea var. bracteata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, which may exert anxiolytic, antidepressant, and antihypertensive effects. Research on this plant has identified the presence of bioactive compounds like flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
